trans-unit.source: Microsoft Clarity is a user-friendly web analytics tool that empowers website visitors like you by providing transparency about how your interactions are tracked on a website. Osigurava poštivanje vaše privatnosti, a programerima i vlasnicima web stranica daje vrijedne uvide u ponašanje korisnika.
